Intellectual Property

Advice that starts with the real issue.

Names, content, software, designs and confidential know-how can carry substantial value. The practice helps clients recognise those assets and take proportionate steps to protect and use them.

How the practice can help.

  • Trade mark and brand-protection guidance
  • Copyright advisory
  • IP clauses in commercial agreements
  • Licensing and permitted-use arrangements
  • Confidentiality and information protection
  • IP dispute guidance

A clear, proportionate approach.

Advice starts with the asset, its commercial role and the risk that matters most, avoiding protection measures that are disconnected from how the client operates.
